verdict.rationale: Windmill documents inbound webhook endpoints that trigger scripts and flows, including version-pinned flow webhooks. It also supports many event triggers (HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, Event Grid and others), so external event sources can push events into Windmill. However, nothing in the pack shows outbound webhook subscriptions to Windmill's own platform events, such as job completion or failure notifications. Missing for 10: outbound webhook subscriptions to platform events, event-type catalog/payload docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
